main_text.head: TRACTATUS DE COELO TERRESTRI, VENCESLAI LAVINII MORAVI.
main_text.p: VNus est spiritus corporeus à Natura primò creatus, communis, occultus, vitæ pretiosum: conservans pura & bona, impura & mala destruens. Is est finis & initium omnis creaturæ, triplex in substātia, ex sale, sulphure, & Mercurio, sive aqua pura, qui coagulat, unit & congregat, irrigatq; hæc inferiora loca omnia per siccum unctuosum & humidum, ex loco superiori. Hoc est habile & aptum ad recipiendum quamlibet formam & figuram. Sola ars mediante natura oculis nostris visibilem reddit: in ventre suo celat & occultat infinitam vim & virtutē: refer-

page.notes: The first letter V is a large woodcut-style initial. Text reads "refer-" as a hyphenated catchword at the foot. The word "Is est" and "superiori. Hoc" have a printed punctuation irregularity; the "s" long s is rendered as s. Some words in the scan are faint: "substātia", "virtutē" reproduced as printed.
